news.headline: US court backs Bybit’s bid to trace funds from $1.5B North Korea hack
news.summary: A US court has greenlit expedited discovery in Bybit's case to trace funds from a $1.5B North Korean hack, letting the exchange identify account holders and track balances across platforms with US operations. This accelerated legal route could help recover stolen crypto and set precedent for exchange asset recovery in cross-border theft cases.

educational.title: Why Company Earnings Move Stock Prices So Much
points: Stock prices reflect expectations — earnings reports test if those expectations were right
Beating profit estimates doesn't guarantee a stock rises if guidance disappoints
'Guidance' — a company's own forecast — often matters more than the past quarter
Markets move on the surprise, not the number itself
This is why a profitable company's stock can still crash on earnings day
